title: Sparkly pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pencil body -->
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='24' height='52' rx='3' fill='#FFD34E'/>
  <!-- pencil body lighter stripe -->
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='8' height='52' rx='3' fill='#FFE88A'/>
  <!-- pencil body darker edge -->
  <rect x='56' y='22' width='6' height='52' rx='2' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <!-- metal ferrule -->
  <rect x='36' y='70' width='28' height='10' rx='2' fill='#B8C4CE'/>
  <rect x='36' y='70' width='8' height='10' rx='2' fill='#DCE6EE'/>
  <rect x='56' y='70' width='8' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8E9AA6'/>
  <!-- eraser -->
  <rect x='37' y='80' width='26' height='9' rx='4' fill='#FF8FA3'/>
  <rect x='37' y='80' width='8' height='9' rx='4' fill='#FFB3C1'/>
  <!-- wood cone -->
  <polygon points='38,22 62,22 50,6' fill='#F2C58A'/>
  <polygon points='38,22 50,22 50,6' fill='#FFDCA8'/>
  <!-- graphite tip -->
  <polygon points='46,12 54,12 50,4' fill='#5B5470'/>
  <polygon points='46,12 50,12 50,4' fill='#8A7FA6'/>
  <!-- sparkle 1 top-left -->
  <g fill='#7FE9FF'>
    <polygon points='18,16 20,22 26,24 20,26 18,32 16,26 10,24 16,22'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 2 right -->
  <g fill='#FFE88A'>
    <polygon points='80,40 82,46 88,48 82,50 80,56 78,50 72,48 78,46'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 3 bottom-left -->
  <g fill='#FFB3C1'>
    <polygon points='24,66 26,71 31,73 26,75 24,80 22,75 17,73 22,71'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 4 top-right small -->
  <g fill='#B8FFC1'>
    <polygon points='74,14 75.5,18 79.5,19.5 75.5,21 74,25 72.5,21 68.5,19.5 72.5,18'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 5 bottom-right tiny -->
  <g fill='#7FE9FF'>
    <polygon points='82,72 83.5,76 87.5,77.5 83.5,79 82,83 80.5,79 76.5,77.5 80.5,76'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny dot sparkle -->
  <circle cx='10' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='#FFD34E'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='60' r='2.2' fill='#FF8FA3'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='10' r='2' fill='#B8C4CE'/>
</svg>
